mapper.select: SELECT MIN(tr_date) FROM tbl_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND is_excluded_from_summary = 0 AND is_refund = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE AND t.is_refund = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN t.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(t.refunded_amount, t.amount) ELSE t.amount END ), 0) FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.id AS category_id, p.category_name AS parent_category_name, c.category_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(t.refunded_amount, t.amount) ELSE t.amount END) AS total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_refund = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transaction_count FROM tbl_transaction t JOIN tbl_category c ON c.id = t.category_id JOIN tbl_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_mission_pool mp WHERE mp.category_id = c.id AND mp.mission_type = 'RELATIVE' ) GROUP BY c.id, p.category_name, c.category_name HAVING total_amount > 0 ORDER BY total_amount DESC, transaction_count DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
